label: Causal Layered Analysis
description: Moves from surface events into systems, worldviews, and deep metaphors, critically revealing hidden assumptions and reframing the design question underneath.

text_output_forms.primary_template: four-layer excavation table, reframed question, metaphor swap, and interpretive questions

required_blocks.title: Reframed question
required_blocks.purpose: Reframe the design issue from the deepest useful layer.

text_output_forms.presentation_rule: Clearly separate observed evidence from interpretation. Do not make the four layers into a solution checklist.

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf pages 16-17. External futures/design research tool.

model_constraints: Move from surface events to systems, worldview, and deep metaphor.
Do not stop at policy or technical fixes.
Use the deeper layers to reframe the design question.
Make value assumptions visible before generating artifacts.
For text outputs, return the package text_blocks sequence and use the evidence-or-interpretation column to prevent false certainty.

ui.short_description: Analyze surface, system, worldview, and metaphor layers.

recommendation.reason: Causal Layered Analysis is a deep diagnostic tool; text is best for separating litany, system, worldview, and metaphor before any visual synthesis.
best_when: The input looks like an operational issue but may hide deeper values or narratives.
The user needs reframing rather than immediate artifact generation.
The output should reveal assumptions behind a discourse, policy, or public problem.

avoid: image output before the layers are explicit

warnings: This tool should not stop at visible symptoms; require all four layers.
